West Coast Industries: Aerospace Tooling | AMT PostPro
West Coast Industries: cost-efficient aerospace tooling

West Coast Industries, an aircraft and aerospace tooling manufacturer, worked with GoProto Inc, a product development and custom manufacturing firm in San Diego, California, to produce highly durable parts.

West Coast Industries uses a metal portable tool to drill high-precision holes in loaded aircraft components. Compressed air drives the tool through a 2.5 HP air motor, and the hot air became an issue for operators’ hands. The tools are also dropped often, and the material and shape of the handle made them expensive to replace. The fragile parts had become a major issue in the production chain.

The full case study shows how West Coast Industries saved time and money while improving part performance, with parts finished on PostPro3D, the earlier generation of AMT’s automated vapor smoothing systems.

Raise3D, a global provider of 3D printing solutions, today announced a partnership with Additive Manufacturing Technologies (AMT) to bring professional post-processing capabilities to its RMS220 SLS 3D printer. The collaboration enables businesses to produce functional, end-use parts with high-quality surface finishes more efficiently.

“Our partnership with Additive Manufacturing Technologies (AMT) completes our additive manufacturing workflow with advanced post-processing capabilities. AMT’s powerful yet user-friendly systems […] perfectly complement the large build volume of our RMS220. This collaboration represents another step toward our goal of delivering a complete, end-to-end additive manufacturing solution.”

“Our partnership with Raise3D is about empowering businesses to manufacture real, functional end-use parts without the traditional cost and complexity. The combination of Raise3D’s accessible SLS technology and AMT’s PostPro SF2X vapor smoothing creates a […] production cell that delivers professional results […]. This is additive manufacturing for real-world applications, made simple.”

Raise3D is a global provider of additive manufacturing solutions, developing 3D printers, materials, and software for professional and industrial applications. With offices in Europe, the United States, and Shanghai, Raise3D is an ISO9001:2015 and ISO14001 certified company helping organizations adopt flexible, digital manufacturing.

Over the past decade, Raise3D has built a complete additive manufacturing ecosystem integrating FFF, DLP, and SLS technologies, enabling companies to move from prototyping to end use production with a fully integrated workflow.
